exactGap: Much of phase 1's plumbing exists: org-scoped API keys are already minted, listed and revoked end to end (auth-core better-auth apiKey plugin behind API_KEY_ENABLED with per-key rate limits and a validate RPC, gateway settings/api_keys.rs, action ids settings.create_api_key and settings.delete_api_key), and the action registry already builds a deterministic JSON-Schema catalog (catalog-manifest.ts) behind /api/v1/actions/catalog and /execute. What is missing is the consumer side: gateway require_session accepts only the Better Auth session cookie, no route verifies x-api-key, the gateway mints org-keys with a hard-coded [read] scope that nothing enforces, and there is no OpenAPI or SDK for gateway routes (only Model Plane has api/openapi.yaml with generated TS and Python SDKs). Phases 2 to 4 are absent: the Convex webhooks table is schema only with no delivery code, there is no external bot identity, and the plugin registry in agent_actions.rs is an admin enable and pin toggle, not a catalogue.
reuse: auth-core apiKey plugin with its user-keys and org-keys configs, per-key rate limit, and the validate RPC (orpc-router.ts:2717-2790)
gateway settings/api_keys.rs and the settings.create_api_key and settings.delete_api_key actions for issuance and revocation UI
buildActionCatalogManifest (zod to JSON Schema, sorted, hashable) as the source for an OpenAPI document
Model Plane api/generate-sdk.sh and openapitools.json for the SDK generation pipeline
gateway rate_limit.rs distributed token bucket with Retry-After, adding a token-keyed source
Convex spaceLifecycleEvents transactional outbox with claim leases as the pattern for phase 2 event delivery
model-eligibility.ts classification to decide which actions an external agent may invoke
constraints: Space authority (ADR-0001) binds every Control decision to an authenticated subject, so scoped tokens must be user-bound (auth-core user-keys, which exists) or a Control-registered service principal with explicit Space grants; the org-keys the gateway mints today carry no subject and would widen access if mapped to Space routes. Control mints, validates and revokes, while the gateway only enforces, and an API key must resolve to an AuthenticatedUser that then runs the same membership, Control decision and audit path as the UI. The registry covers only 14 spaces.* management writes (reading threads, work and activity are plain routes, and posting a message is the model-gateway chat invoke path), and Application outbox events must apply ZDR and privacy-tier filtering before leaving the plane.
approachAdjustment: Reword phase 1 as extend, not build: issue user-bound keys with real scopes (action ids plus an optional Space allowlist) instead of the hard-coded org read scope; add an x-api-key branch to require_session that calls the auth-core validate RPC, builds an AuthenticatedUser and keys rate_limit_key by token; generate OpenAPI from buildActionCatalogManifest and extend it to any read routes made public; decide explicitly how an external caller posts to a room, since that is the Model Plane invoke path and not a registry action. Keep TS from the generator and drop Rust clients from phase 1 unless a customer asks.
effortNote: Phase 1 stays L because of the auth-path, scope, audit and per-token limit security review, even though issuance, catalog manifest and limiter exist; phases 2 to 4 are separate M to L items.
verdictReason: The item reads as if token minting and a typed schema export are new, but both exist in part; the real gap is gateway-side token authentication with Space-safe scopes, and the registry alone does not cover reading or posting.

exactGap: Server-side operability is further along than the item assumes: model-gateway already drains on SIGTERM (drain.rs, 120 s default, readyz 503), exports a gateway_active_streams gauge, emits 15 s keep-alive comment frames and a content-free turn_timing event, so the missing pieces are on the client and the Frontend Plane gateway. The SPA reader skips comment frames (sse.ts:106) so there is no stall or buffering detection, nothing shares a connection across tabs (no BroadcastChannel, SharedWorker, Web Locks, Idle Detection or PerformanceObserver in src), the connected frame carries only ok, request_id, run_id, thread_id and model (sse.rs:2165), and the Frontend gateway serves with axum::serve and no graceful shutdown (main.rs:82, compose stop_grace_period 20 s). Much of it is premature for Spaces: the room has no push stream (6 s visible-tab poll, SpacePage.tsx:87), the Space composer has no attachments or media route so the Range, ETag and no-store slice has nothing to apply to, and the monitoring domain the item names for vitals is Quarry change monitoring, not telemetry.
reuse: model-gateway drain.rs pattern (readyz 503, wait for registered streams, bounded window) for the Frontend gateway
server keep-alive comment frames (sse.rs with_keep_alive, ag_ui.rs KeepAlive) as the liveness signal for a client watchdog
gateway observability.rs Prometheus recorder for vitals and space_open counters and histograms
turn_timing.rs content-free timing record as the model for ZDR-safe client telemetry
space-live-work.ts module store and the existing visibilitychange gating in SpacePage.tsx
Last-Event-ID resume already implemented in sse.ts, chat-client.ts and run-console-client.ts
constraints: New SSE events or connected-frame fields are CI-gated: the SPA chat-client.ts and the taxonomy doc must agree with sse_events.rs (sse-taxonomy.yml). Capability advertisement belongs to Model Plane's connected frame, telemetry to the Frontend gateway observability layer, and neither may carry content under ZDR. Any media route added later must send no-store for ZDR Spaces and re-check Space authority on every Range request, and a leader-tab multiplexer has nothing persistent to multiplex until Spaces have a push subscription.
approachAdjustment: Split into build-now and after-push. Build now: make readSseStream surface comment frames as a liveness tick and arm a stall watchdog (the server already sends the heartbeats, so no new diagnostics stream is needed except for an optional IT self-test); add graceful shutdown and a stream gauge to the Frontend gateway by copying model-gateway drain.rs and raising stop_grace_period; post vitals and space_open marks through a small gateway telemetry route backed by observability.rs, not the monitoring domain. After push ships: leader-tab sharing and capability fields in the connected frame. Drop the media cache slice until Space attachments exist.
effortNote: Buildable now is S (watchdog), S (gateway drain), S to M (vitals); leader-tab sharing is M and deferred until a persistent subscription exists, and the media slice is dropped.
verdictReason: Heartbeats, drain and an active-stream gauge already exist in model-gateway, the named vitals target is the wrong domain, and the media and leader-tab slices have no substrate yet, so the item needs rewording and splitting rather than keeping as is.

exactGap: The pieces exist but are not joined: integration-corev2 already implements search-shaped provider reads (Outlook $search/KQL and Gmail q via mail.messages and gmail.messages, calendar query, drive.files search, Slack messages.list) and the gateway exposes a read-only per-connection browse proxy as the signed-in user (integrations/browse.rs READ_ONLY_BROWSE_OPS), but only the home composer's connector-attach picker calls it. There is no Space search endpoint or UI, no fan-out orchestrator with failed[] and limited[] (the Knowledge workspace aggregator fans out but is not a search), no Session Core message search, and no per-backend Control decision for provider reads (browse uses the user's ingestion-audience token). Data Plane retrieval-engine already enforces x-space-decision on /v1/knowledge/search, but the gateway calls that route only org-wide (knowledge/retrieval.rs:102) and uses space-sources for the Knowledge tab (spaces.rs:1819).
reuse: integration-corev2 mail, calendar, drive and Slack read actions with their validated query params
gateway integrations/browse.rs allowlist and proxy_for_user as the provider backend transport
retrieval-engine /v1/knowledge/search under x-space-decision plus proxy_data_plane_json_with_space_decision

SpaceKnowledgePanel per-section gap rendering for failed[] and limited[]
constraints: Each backend must run as the asking user with its own Control decision, and Space access must never widen an owner-plane ACL, so provider search may use only connections the asker may use (user versus org-shared connection ownership was not verified). Provider results must not be cached or indexed and must stay out of the gateway's Dragonfly ResultCache, and ZDR must propagate by keeping results transient and content out of logs. The orchestrator is Frontend Plane gateway code over owner-plane APIs with no cross-plane DB access, and Session Core has no message search to plug in yet.
approachAdjustment: Replace the unverified-existence dependency with verified primitives and build the orchestrator as the F-t1-069 fan-out in order of readiness: Data Plane documents and wiki under the Space decision (exists), then provider mail, files and calendar through the existing browse allowlist, then Session Core messages once message search exists. Give each provider backend a Control decision (Space, purpose, privacy class) instead of reusing the picker's audience token, and return {hits, failed[], limited[]}. Fix execution-core's integration_tools.rs catalog text, which still says no query filter is implemented, before any agent-side federated search.
effortNote: Unchanged: the provider primitives exist, but the orchestrator, per-backend Control decisions, Space search UI and message search do not.
verdictReason: Provider-level search and a per-connection browse proxy already ship, and the item still lists their existence as unverified; the recommendation is valid but should be scoped to the missing orchestrator and Space-bound decisions.

exactGap: No desktop shell of any kind exists: the Frontend Plane is a Vite SPA with no manifest or service worker, no Tauri, Electron or MSIX files exist outside node_modules, the gateway has no desktop sign-in, protocol-link or updater endpoint, and auth-core has no PKCE or code-challenge route. The only native code in the monorepo is Endpoint Plane's verevon-agent, a Rust remote-desktop host whose own docs list packaging and installer as out of scope, and .github/workflows holds no signing or installer pipeline. Notifications are in-app only (gateway notifications.rs list, unread and preference routes), so tray, badge and OS notification bridges are also absent.

constraints: Frontend Plane owns the shell, but the desktop sign-in handoff is Control Plane (auth-core) work because the session is a Better Auth HttpOnly cookie minted behind the gateway and no PKCE endpoint exists. effortNote: Unchanged: native shell, bridge, protocol handling, sign-in handoff, signed installers and an update channel are all new.
verdictReason: The shell is accurately described as absent, nothing in the repo already covers it, and the proposed plane placement matches the session and CSP constraints.

An inbound MCP endpoint is a new authenticated surface that depends on the same external token authentication as F-t1-076, and every exposed tool must first earn model eligibility with an owner-governed receipt and forged-call denial per the model-eligibility rules; export must use an explicit field allowlist so secrets cannot serialize.
approachAdjustment: Split the bundle: role-tagged templates plus an optional self-introduction (S), a catch-up summary action with time windows that calls Model Plane under the room read decision (M), owner-reviewed config proposals as an Application proposal object with a prefilled owner dialog (M), definition export with a field allowlist and a leak test (M), and the external MCP surface as its own XL item after F-t1-076 token authentication and eligible spaces.* actions exist. effortNote: Raised from M: the first four slices are each S to M, but the MCP surface alone is XL (no inbound server, empty model-eligible Space action list, depends on external token auth), so the bundle as written is L or larger.
verdictReason: Templates, definition re-binding and a scribe-style catch-up partly exist, the proposal pattern exists in other domains, and the MCP surface is much larger than the other slices, so the item should be split and its status stated as partial rather than absent.

exactGap: None of the three proposals exists, only foundations: presence is already gated on tab visibility with a 6 s beat (SpacePage.tsx:206-250, Convex presence TTL 30 s and typing 8 s) but has no input-idle or away state, navbar and notification unread counts are computed for the active organization only (notifications.rs unread_count, navbar.rs unreadCount), and the org switcher lists organizations without counts (CoreNavbar.tsx:685-735). There is no pop-out or compact route: window.open appears only for provider sign-in, search results and Knowledge links, and AgentRunConsole is a page-level component with local state that takes no run id parameter, although it can replay a chosen history run through streamRunEvents (AgentRunConsole.tsx:329). Nothing coordinates tabs (no BroadcastChannel, SharedWorker or Web Locks), and the active organization is server-side session state (orgs/switch.rs:58), so every window in a browser shares one active org.
reuse: streamRunEvents with lastEventId resume and the run-event rendering in AgentRunConsole as the pop-out body once extracted

gateway notifications.rs and notification-core unread count, called per org
constraints: Active org is session state, so a pop-out cannot show a different org than the main window, and per-org unread must be computed server-side by the gateway for each of the user's Control memberships under that org's own authorization (counts only, never Space names, in the switcher). Presence is personal data and must stay optional, and adding an away status is an Application Plane change (current status enum is online or typing). A shared connection or leader tab is premature because Space data is polled and only per-turn chat and run-event streams exist.
approachAdjustment: Build in this order: pop-out routes (extract a props-driven run view and add a compact layout flag with run or thread id params), an idle or away presence signal derived from visibility plus input idle in beat(), then a gateway per-org unread-count endpoint feeding the switcher. Defer the SharedWorker or BroadcastChannel multiplexer until a persistent push subscription exists; if duplicate 6 s polls matter sooner, share the polled projection across tabs through BroadcastChannel instead of multiplexing SSE.
effortNote: Unchanged overall but uneven: pop-out S to M, idle signal S, cross-org unread M (per-org authorization), leader-tab multiplexing deferred.
verdictReason: The proposal is accurate that these are missing, but it should drop the SSE multiplexer until a push stream exists, note the shared active-org constraint, and recognise that visibility-gated presence already exists.
